content: कपालः, -लम् [कं शिरो जलं वा पालयति] .²1 The skull, skull bone; चूडापीडकपालसंकुलगलन्मन्दाकिनीवारयः <ls>Māl. 1. 2</ls>; रुद्रो येन कपालपाणिपुटके भिक्षाटनं कारितः <ls>Bh. 2. 95</ls>. .²2 A piece of a broken jar; potsherd; कपालेन भिक्षार्थी <ls>Ms. 8. 93</ls>. .²3 A multitude, collection. .²4 A beggarʼs bowl; <ls>Ms. 6. 44</ls>. .²5 A cup, jar in general; पञ्चकपाल. .²6 A cover or lid. .²7 A treaty of peace on equal terms; <ls>H. 4. 107</ls>; <ls>Kām. 9. 2</ls>. .{@-लम्@} .²1 The shell of an egg. .²2 The cotyla of the leg of a man, any flat bone. .²3 A kind of Leprosy. .{@-ली@} A beggarʼs bowl [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%caput%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%Kephale%}].
